description: RC-L1: lever 1, budgeted cell shading (cellShading 'budget', id Tech 8's way) against Capsaicin's per-hit shading at 1280x720. (1) With a budget above the cells in use, max age 1 and one sample, the converged mean interpolated and denoised E on cornell-box, two-room and sponza (frames 301-332 from an empty cache) within 3% of perHit's, flicker before and after the denoiser beside perHit's, no NaN or negative pixels. (2) On the sunlit corner with budget 5,000 and 3 samples, lit cells = min(budget, cells in use) and shadow rays = lit x 3 exactly, and the cells lit are the CPU twin's choice by age class; again above the cells in use. (2b) With cells in use over the budget, every cell in use is lit within ceil(cells in use over those frames / budget) + 1 frames, and the ages don't grow. (3) Lag on two-room (perHit, budget 1, 1/4, 1/16 of the cells in use; multibounce on and off): frames until the mean E is within 10% of the step after the lamp turns on, a cut to the second bookmark and the lamp off again; with the lamp off, per hit and the ample budget fall under 1% within 720 frames and the smaller budgets are under 1% by 4,096 frames or still falling by 10% over their last 512.
